description: A final, immutable class representing a JSON number that fits within a Java long, including methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLong
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON number that fits in Java's long type, with methods for type checks, equality, serialization, and size estimation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableJsonLong with a specified long value.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the stored value fits within an int range.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Always returns true, as this class specifically represents long values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, optimized for comparison with other AbstractJsonNumber instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the numeric value, optimized by whether it's stored as int or long.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the numeric value using the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates maximum string size needed to represent the number.
